items.review_rationale: Reviewed split Grothendieck fibrations via a strict contravariant category-valued functor and the isomorphism of resulting fibred categories over the same base; distinguished groupoid special case.

references.phrase: Grothendieck construction of a category-valued functor
references.context: Category of pairs (U,x in F(U)) and compatible morphisms, equipped with canonical projection to C.
Categorical isomorphism E≈∫F commuting with the specified functors to C, rather than equivalence ignoring projection.

references.phrase: split fibred category distinct from split fibred groupoid
references.disposition: The strict target is general Cat, not necessarily Groupoids; this formulation does not impose invertibility of every fibre arrow.

items.review_rationale: Read a discrete valuation ring in the Stacks convention through its valuation-ring structure and associated ordered value group isomorphic to Z, preserving ordered rather than abstract group isomorphism.

references.phrase: integers Z as ordered additive group
associated ordered value group of a valuation ring
references.context: Group of values of nonzero elements of its fraction field modulo units, ordered using divisibility/the valuation order.

references.phrase: isomorphism of ordered groups with Z
references.context: Group isomorphism preserving the total order, not merely a bijection of sets or unordered group isomorphism.

references.disposition: The displayed definition uses the ordered value group criterion; it does not directly impose a Noetherian condition or a specified uniformizer.
